title: Keys Two and Six Swapped  (对调的二号和六号钥匙)

segments.t: 回到前台，格雷厄姆正用木工铅笔指着木制钥匙板上的两个空黄铜挂钩，亚瑟摸着额头眨巴着眼睛，汉娜一路小跑急停在柜台前。先听对话。
Report, Graham! Which room keys went sideways during the noon telephone call?
Look at my paper book: two young hikers booked Room Two on the first floor.
Yes, lovely polite hikers — and a quiet lady with a floral hatbox booked Room Six!
Now tell Hannah where your glasses were when you handed out tags Two and Six.
Oh dear... upside down, two becomes five, no — two and six look remarkably similar blurry!
Did the hikers take backpacks to Room Six while the hatbox went to Room Two?!
Lucky for you, boss, both guests dropped their bags outside the doors and went for lunch!
Really?! Neither guest unlocked the wrong room or unpacked a single shirt yet?!
I passed them at the gate two minutes ago asking where to buy noon soup.
Graham, your eyes are worth their weight in gold — can we move the bags right now?
And leave clean welcome notes on each door table explaining the right hook number!
Grab the master ring, Hannah; you take the hatbox, and I have the two backpacks.
汉娜赶回前台查案，结果发现亚瑟没戴老花镜，把二号和六号两拨客人的钥匙牌给拿混了。这一幕充满查账排查和紧急补救的说法，我们逐句来听。
Report, Graham! Which room keys went sideways during the noon telephone call?
'快汇报情况，格雷厄姆！中午接电话的时候是哪几间房的钥匙弄岔了？' 汉娜一进大堂就直奔主题要汇报。习语 go sideways 原意是“横着偏过去”，口语里常比喻事情“出了差错、走偏了”：
Which room keys went sideways
介词 during 表示“在……期间”，后面直接接名词词组即可：
during the noon telephone call
Look at my paper book: two young hikers booked Room Two on the first floor.
'你看我的纸质登记簿：两位年轻的徒步旅行者订了一楼的二号房。' 亚瑟低头对着纸质账本查记录。hikers 指背着包走路远足的“徒步旅行者”，动词 book 在旅馆语境里是“预订房间”：
two young hikers booked Room Two
英语说住在“第几层楼”时，通常用介词 on 搭配序数词：
on the first floor
Yes, lovely polite hikers — and a quiet lady with a floral hatbox booked Room Six!
'对，那两位徒步客人特别有礼貌——还有一位拎着碎花帽盒的文静女士订了六号房！' 汉娜立刻核对另一组入住信息。用 lady 称呼女客人显得端庄客气，hatbox 则是装礼帽的“帽盒”：
a quiet lady with a floral hatbox
这位带着帽盒的女士预订的正是六号房：
booked Room Six
Now tell Hannah where your glasses were when you handed out tags Two and Six.
'现在快告诉汉娜，你把二号和六号钥匙牌发出去的时候，眼镜架在哪儿呢。' 线索串上了，汉娜眯起眼睛反问亚瑟当时眼镜戴没戴上。注意间接疑问句 where your glasses were 要保持正常陈述语序：
where your glasses were
短语动词 hand out 意思是“分发、递出去”，刚好对应前台发钥匙牌的动作：
when you handed out tags Two and Six
Oh dear... upside down, two becomes five, no — two and six look remarkably similar blurry!
'哎呀……倒过来看的话，二字会变成五，不对——模糊起来二和六长得实在太像了！' 亚瑟尴尬得直挠头，赶紧解释倒着看数字怎么闹的乌龙。upside down 是“上下颠倒”，become 表示“变成”：
upside down, two becomes five
后面的 look 加上形容词表示“看起来怎么样”，blurry 形容没戴眼镜时视线“模糊不清”：
look remarkably similar blurry
Did the hikers take backpacks to Room Six while the hatbox went to Room Two?!
'难道徒步客人背着双肩包去了六号房，而那只帽盒被送到了二号房？！' 汉娜顺着这个乌龙一推算，立刻追问双方行李是不是全送错了屋。backpack 由 back 和 pack 合成，就是“双肩背包”：
Did the hikers take backpacks to Room Six
连词 while 把两组同时对调的行李情况并列对比出来：
while the hatbox went to Room Two
Lucky for you, boss, both guests dropped their bags outside the doors and went for lunch!
'算您走运，老板，两边客人都把行李搁在房门外头就出去吃午饭了！' 幸好门房格雷厄姆一直留心着走廊动静，立刻报上好消息。Lucky for you 相当于口语里的“算你走运”：
Lucky for you, boss
去吃午饭常用简短的 go for lunch，过去式就是 went for lunch：
went for lunch
Really?! Neither guest unlocked the wrong room or unpacked a single shirt yet?!
'真的吗？！两边客人都还没有开错门，也没从包里掏出一件衬衫来？！' 汉娜长舒一口气，连连确认真有这么巧。注意 neither 本身就已经包含“两者都不”的否定意味，所以后面的动词保持肯定形式 unlocked：
Neither guest unlocked the wrong room
动词 unpack 加上了否定前缀 un-，正好和“打包行李”pack 相反，意思是“打开行李掏出东西”：
unpacked a single shirt yet
I passed them at the gate two minutes ago asking where to buy noon soup.
'我两分钟前在门口还碰见他们了，正打听上哪儿买中午的热汤喝呢。' 格雷厄姆解释他怎么知道得这么清楚：pass someone 表示“与某人擦肩而过”，ago 依然放在时间段后面：
I passed them at the gate two minutes ago
后面的现在分词短语带出“疑问词 + 不定式”结构 where to buy，说明客人正在打听买汤的地方：
asking where to buy noon soup
Graham, your eyes are worth their weight in gold — can we move the bags right now?
'格雷厄姆，你这双眼睛简直金不换——咱们现在能把行李换过去吗？' 危机瞬间解除了大半，汉娜激动地把格雷厄姆的火眼金睛夸成“价值连城”。be worth one's weight in gold 是很经典的赞美习语：
your eyes are worth their weight in gold
夸完立刻问能不能马上动手换包，用 can we 发出干脆利落的提议：
can we move the bags right now
And leave clean welcome notes on each door table explaining the right hook number!
'再在每间房门边的小桌子上留一张工整的欢迎便条，写明正确的钥匙挂钩号！' 格雷厄姆不仅同意，还想出了周全的善后办法：welcome note 指给客人的“欢迎便条”，each 后面接单数名词：
leave clean welcome notes on each door table
句尾直接用现在分词 explaining 补充说明便条内容，比啰嗦地加定语从句更简练：
explaining the right hook number
Grab the master ring, Hannah; you take the hatbox, and I have the two backpacks.
'拿上总钥匙圈，汉娜；你去拎那只帽盒，这两个双肩包归我扛。' 汉娜行动派本色再现，马上指挥大家抄家伙开工。master ring 指串着能开所有房门的“万能总钥匙圈”：
Grab the master ring, Hannah
句尾的 I have the... 在干活分工时并不单纯指“拥有”，而是“这几件包在我身上”：
I have the two backpacks
有总钥匙和门房大叔压阵，这点小插曲转眼就能摆平。现在，再把这段惊险又搞笑的查错经过完整听一遍。
Report, Graham! Which room keys went sideways during the noon telephone call?
Look at my paper book: two young hikers booked Room Two on the first floor.
Yes, lovely polite hikers — and a quiet lady with a floral hatbox booked Room Six!
Now tell Hannah where your glasses were when you handed out tags Two and Six.
Oh dear... upside down, two becomes five, no — two and six look remarkably similar blurry!
Did the hikers take backpacks to Room Six while the hatbox went to Room Two?!
Lucky for you, boss, both guests dropped their bags outside the doors and went for lunch!
Really?! Neither guest unlocked the wrong room or unpacked a single shirt yet?!
I passed them at the gate two minutes ago asking where to buy noon soup.
Graham, your eyes are worth their weight in gold — can we move the bags right now?
And leave clean welcome notes on each door table explaining the right hook number!
Grab the master ring, Hannah; you take the hatbox, and I have the two backpacks.
多亏了菩提树街那家的午间热汤，汉娜和格雷厄姆赢出了十五分钟，能把每件行李都放回正确的房门前！我们待会儿楼上见。
See you next time!
